behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert pure add/reset/save state/effect outputs and input preservation.
Assert controller effect order, pre-effect state commit and first-error behavior.
docDelivery: Describe reducer contract and controller delegation/effect order.
Explain clamping, save-even-unchanged, invalid events and legacy no-rollback error semantics.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Bounded synchronous counter transitions and ordered effects, explicit commit-before-effects error semantics; pure reducer.
manualBehavior: Verify controller delegates transition computation to reduceCounter and executes returned effects; no duplicate event transition implementation remains. Pure core must not call adapters or external state.
independence: Extract deterministic state reducer from an effectful counter controller and preserve effect order via returned actions.
